subject: A question about the INLA crashed

messages.author: c3cde982f551021c
messages.subject: A question about the INLA crashed
parts:
Dear professors:
    Greetings.
    I recently ran into an issue regarding INLA crashing and I don't know how to fix it. The details are as follows: i am running a disaggregation model using INLA involving 81 provincial regions with a total of 108 months of data from 2011 to 2019. There are more than 2,000 mesh triangle vertices and more than 17,000 grid points to be predicted in the whole space. In the model formulation, I consider a spatio-temporal interaction effect with a matern field for the spatial random effect and an AR1 for the temporal random effect.The code works fine when I consider only 1 year, i.e., 12 months of data, but it crashed when I try to run it for all 108 months of data. Please tell me what to do with it.
    Also below is the model  formulation and the main part of the inla code, if you still need more information I am more than happy to provide it.

parts:
sorry for late reply.

I would guess it runs out of memory. if you run with option

verbose=TRUE

it should be more clear.

I can rerun it here if you like to check, if you share code/data

best
havard
